Thanks for the PR. Please fill this out so the list stays healthy.

## What are you adding or changing?

Brief description of the entry or edit.

## Who are you?

One line on your connection to ActionKit or this project. Optional but helpful.

## Checklist

- [ ] Entry follows the format: `- [Name](URL) - Description.` (period at end, single line)
- [ ] Description is objective and factual — no marketing language
- [ ] Entry is placed in the correct section and in alphabetical order (unless a section is intentionally ordered)
- [ ] URL is public and reachable (no authwalls, no placeholder links)
- [ ] If commercial, the entry is under **Commercial add-ons** and tagged `paid`
- [ ] `npx awesome-lint` passes locally

## Anything else?

Context, caveats, or questions for the maintainer.
